The Gooreng Gooreng are an Aboriginal Australian people of central Queensland, an inland freshwater people whose country runs from the Boyne Valley in the north, inland of Gladstone, toward the Burnett River around Bundaberg and west to the Great Dividing Range.

The name also covers their language group. Their neighbours were the Bayali near Gladstone, the Wuli Wuli inland, and the Butchulla and Gubbi Gubbi to the south. Sheep and cattle runs reached the Burnett in the 1840s, and sugar cane later took the coastal plains around Bundaberg.
